integrity: Finite exhaustive proof with two independently organized enumeration algorithms and hand-derived trinomial support orders. No extrapolation from samples or independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-field result for quartic factors over the single field GF(8); does not classify arbitrary q or all degrees. Generic cyclotomic factorization formulas compute the underlying factors, and could implicitly yield this census; possible unindexed equivalent classifications remain.
title: Complete quartic cyclotomic coefficient-weight spectrum over \(\mathbb F_8\)
